value.heroText: You validated Lucas's frustration with gentle limits and helped him practice careful play.
value.topMomentCelebration: You noticed Lucas handling items carefully and encouraged his positive effort with warm praise.
value.interactionTip: Adding specific details to your praise will clearly show Lucas which gentle behaviors you love seeing.

crisisMoment.title: Frustration Over Limits
crisisMoment.description: Lucas became upset when he was not allowed to take everything out of the container. You validated his feelings to help calm his frustration before it escalated.
